1.label: very_easy
1.summary: One of two attributes; two wide fixed mouths and one stable lane.
1.natural_language: Discover the cabinet rule through calibration feedback, then start the belt and file every specimen into the matching drawer mouth. After START BELT, specimens and mouths remain at stable visible positions until you act. A release into the cabinet that misses a mouth, a wrong file or early seal ends the case. Release back onto the belt to cancel safely. Calibration feedback and interrupted or returned uncommitted tabs are safe corrections. The first committed failure ends the episode; later attempts cannot earn a pass. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
